title: Life Insurance
intro: Indian life insurers compared on IRDAI data for FY2024-25: death-claim settlement, solvency, size, persistency and complaints. Check the specific plan premium before buying.
sources: IRDAI Handbook on Indian Insurance Statistics 2024-25 (Part I, Tables 10, 15, 21, 23, 28, 37)

params.label: Claim settlement (by count)
params.tip: Individual death claims paid as % of claims decided, FY2024-25 (IRDAI). Industry: 97.82%.

params.label: Claim settlement (by amount)
params.tip: Value of individual death claims paid as % of value decided, FY2024-25 (IRDAI). Industry: 96.29%.

params.label: Solvency ratio
params.tip: Available vs required capital as at 31 Mar 2025 (IRDAI). Legal minimum is 1.5x.

params.label: AUM (Rs crore)
params.tip: Assets under management as at 31 Mar 2025 (IRDAI). Shows size, not quality.

params.label: 13th-month persistency
params.tip: Share of policies (by premium) still paid in month 13, FY2024-25 (IRDAI). Higher suggests fewer mis-sold policies.

params.label: Complaints per 10,000 policies
params.tip: Grievances reported in FY2024-25 per 10,000 individual policies in force at 31 Mar 2025; computed from IRDAI Tables 37 and 10.

params.label: Popular plans
params.tip: Well-known plans from the insurer website, Oct 2026. Not a recommendation.

items.name: LIC

v.plans: New Jeevan Anand, Jeevan Umang, Tech Term

pros: Very large: AUM of Rs 48.00 lakh crore (Mar 2025)
Few complaints: 2.76 per 10,000 policies in force (FY25)
Government-owned, with the widest agent and branch network
cons: Claim settlement by count 97.59% in FY25, below the 97.82% industry figure
Settled only 96.08% of death-claim value in FY25 (industry 96.29%)
Low 13th-month persistency of 64.12% (FY25): many policies lapse in year one
Online term and claim servicing is less smooth than the top private insurers
items.best: Traditional endowment and guaranteed plans with state backing
